question: The materials, through which things can be seen, are called _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**transparent materials.**__​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Transparent Materials:-**

 
 
• **The materials, through which things can be seen, are called transparent materials.**
 
• Transparent materials allow light to pass through them completely without scattering it. This is why we can see objects clearly through them.
 
• Some examples of transparent materials are:
 
 
• Glass
 
• Water
 
• Air
 
• Clear plastic
 
• Diamonds
 
 
 
• **Transparent materials are used in a variety of applications, such as eyeglasses, windows, lenses, and telescopes.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Opaque materials:-**

 
 
• The materials are those that do not allow light to pass through them. When light strikes an opaque material, it is either absorbed or reflected. This is why we cannot see through opaque materials.
 
 
 
• **Translucent materials:-**
 
 
• These are those that allow light to pass through them, but scatter it in a way that objects behind the material are not clearly visible.
 
• This creates a unique visual effect that can be used in a wide variety of applications, from architecture to fashion.
 
 
 
• **Conductive materials:-**
 
 
• These are those that allow electricity to flow through them. This is because they have a large number of free electrons that can move around and carry the electric current.
